title: Spiritual Successor to one of my favourite RPGs in the 80s
author: Epyx911
selftext:
My first computer was a Commodore 64...my first RPG was Phantasie. Man did I love that series...was like D&D but on a pc.  They made 1 to 3 in North America...Phantasie 4 in Japan and apparently a browser version of 5 Phantasie Ressurection. 

However, I wanted to pay hommage to the first 3 and honestly SSI in general.  Combat has been modernized to be more tactical with a lot of the feel of WIzard's Crown thrown in...in my opinion that game was way ahead of its time.  Its still very rough but its playable from start to finish. Been working on it for 3 weeks now.   
  
  
Using the following tools:

Fable 5+ChatGPT 5.6.   
This was done in phases...first was the rule set. then the game design document and then iterations to get everything tied together.    
Photoshop was used for menus/buttons etc.

Artwork for tiles and items is from David Baumgart (Artist for Dungeons of Dredmore) via Unity asset store

Monsters were done in same palette and art style via Chatgpt.  
Music is using Suno.

I have friends playtesting it and am now fixing bugs/polishing.

comments.author: connected_user93
comments.body: The art really needs an overhaul, much like most of the games posted here. If you can't tell how or why it looks generic or bad than you need find an artistic friend who can. You can create art assets that don't look this way using AI but it is pretty much a separate endeavour from coding the game itself.
